snippet.title: Village in the Shade - Announcement Trailer (Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, PC)
snippet.description:
Quiet countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.

Welcome to Village in the Shade, coming to Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC fall 2026! In this brand-new, hand-painted farming sim (known in Japan as "Honogurashi no Niwa"), you'll plant crops, customize your homestead, and befriend a cast of intriguing characters.

Just make sure you follow a few simple rules: don't talk to strangers, don't leave the village, and, whatever you do, don't go out at night.

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://nisamerica.com/village-in-the-shade

#VillageintheShade
